posts.title: ExMex 2026 Notes
posts.description: This week I was a first-time attendee at ExMex , a single-track Elixir conference in Austin, Texas. This is a smaller, more intimate event (~40-50 people), and small events are just as enjoyable to me as the larger ones. The smaller venue creates a more unique social experience, and this one had a great mix of introductions and connections with existing online friends for me. The ExMex 2026 group

posts.title: New Job at RxVortex
posts.description: I have some big news to share. I started a new full-time job at RxVortex . RxVortex is a youngish startup company building a software platform for compound pharmacies. A compound pharmacy mixes personalized medicine, often because of a special need or an allergy concern. posts.title: My Plans for WoW: Forever
posts.description: On November 4th, Blizzard is releasing a new flavor of World of Warcraft called WoW: Forever . I’ve been playing WoW on and off since Vanilla. My most recent stretch was on the “Classic Anniversary” servers, which started with the Vanilla content and then moved into The Burning Crusade.
